record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare LAVA_PLUME: Magcargo (2 stars) and Slugma (1 star). The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star count, range and maxPP. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Spends maxPP, then takes the cells returned by Board.getCellsInFront(caster, target) (range 1: the three neighbouring cells in the 8-way direction faced toward the cast target and the two directions next to it, off-board cells dropped), draws an EMBER board effect on each of them and deals SPECIAL damage (raw 20/40/80/160 by the caster's stars) to every unit standing there that is on the other team. The cast target itself is hit only if it stands in one of those cells; it is used mainly for the facing direction. No status effect, no displacement.

targeting.who: units of the other team standing in the up-to-three cells in front of the caster; allies and empty cells take no damage
targeting.note: Board.getCellsInFront sets the caster's orientation from Board.orientation(caster, target) (8 directions, by the sign of the coordinate differences), then adds the neighbour cell in that direction and in the two adjacent directions of OrientationArray. A target further away than one cell is therefore not necessarily damaged. Only occupied cells with cell.value.team !== pokemon.team are damaged; the board effect is added for all of them. Units standing beside a wall get fewer cells.

geometry.shape: cone of up to 3 adjacent cells (facing direction and its two neighbouring directions), range 1; no extension with range because getCellsInFront is called with its default range of 1

effects.target: each enemy-team unit standing in a cell returned by getCellsInFront
effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1]. handleSpecialDamage then: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost is not overridden, default true); x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false, so only with ABILITY_CRIT); x2 once with DOUBLE_DAMAGE; x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT (the exact multiplier sources are in handleSpecialDamage).
effects.resolution: requested vs applied vs taken: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage then applies attacker/field/weather multipliers, divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the shield absorb first; takenDamage = shield damage + HP damage (HP part capped at current hp); protect / skydiving / magicBounce make it 0 (a Magic Bounce target is not damaged here). Each hit target is handled separately; the returned takenDamage / death are not used by this ability.

starBehavior.note: Damage is indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 3-star (80) and 4-star (160, also the ?? fallback) values are not reachable by the bare factory star counts of the listed units. Range of the shape does not depend on stars. Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Everything depends on the caster's position and on the direction toward the cast target: the damaged cells are the up-to-three neighbours in that direction and the two adjacent directions, minus off-board cells. A cell is damaged only if an enemy-team unit stands there at cast time (the cell list carries the value read at call time).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP and increments the caster's ult counter; every cast recomputes the cells from the target's current position. The caster's orientation is overwritten by getCellsInFront.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 20/40 (Slugma 1 star / Magcargo 2 stars) per enemy in the cone. Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional crit / double-damage / steam multipliers, then SPE_DEF division and minimum 1 in handleDamage; takenDamage includes shield damage. No stat helper, held item (Big Eater Belt, Twist Band) or status clamp is involved in the ability itself; they only matter through the generic damage path.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Which unit is the cast target and when the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, targeting) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
Later handleDamage branches (Shiny Charm, Fossil shield, Cover Band, death handling) were not read
pokemon.broadcastAbility client animation is not modelled
unresolved: Which cells are covered for a given caster/target offset follows Board.orientation (8 sectors); the exact sector boundaries were read in the 'orient' evidence but not enumerated per offset
Whether the three units ever reach a different star count than the bare factory value
Whether a target outside the cone (distance > 1) can be selected for a range-1 caster is a targeting question and was not examined
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
